name: Status:waiting-owner

name: Status:waiting-external
description: Parked: waiting on something outside the repository

name: Status:in-progress
description: Started by its owner (router.hand_over_above counts the rest)

name: Status:waiting-backlog
description: The owner's only: a feature not scheduled now; never a bug or stuck work

name: Urgent
description: The owner's only: checked and merged before every other pull request

description: The owner's only: its merge doesn't cut the Merger's trains

name: Check:rerun
description: Run the build check on this head once more; say why in a comment

name: Review:armed
description: Reviewed; the reviewer's approval posts once the check is green

name: task
description: Neither a defect nor a proposed change
